scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply maple --local && wrangler dev --port ${MAPLE_PORT:-8788}
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

GITHUB_ORG.description: Your GitHub organization's login (the `acme` in github.com/acme), whose members can sign in, or your own username for a factory just for you. After deploying, open `/setup` (as an owner of the org, or as yourself) to create the GitHub App.

RELEASE_CHANNEL.description: `stable`, or `beta` for runner releases before they're stable.

DB.description: The factory's database: members, machines and settings.

RELEASES.description: The factory's files in R2. **R2 must be switched on in this account first** ([R2 in the dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/r2/overview)), or this deploy fails.
